exercises.title: Character Stats
hints: Check your variable names - they must match exactly (case-sensitive)
Strings need quotes, numbers and booleans don't
Make sure you declared ALL four variables: characterName, level, experience, hasUltimate
exercises.explanation: Each variable type serves a purpose: strings for text data, numbers for quantities and calculations, booleans for true/false states. The print statement uses string interpolation with curly braces {} to embed variable values directly in the output string.

exercises.title: Damage Calculator
hints: The critical multiplier should be exactly 2, not 1.5 or 2.0
Use inline if: (if isCritical then 2 else 1)
Check that your function returns a value

exercises.title: Pulse Animation
hints: Make sure you're accumulating time with += not =
Wait for the console to show time=2.0, then copy that line
